Mod.Name: Besiege-Braids-Synth
Mod.Author: wizz6rd
Mod.Description:
A macro-oscillator block: a port of Mutable Instruments' Braids. Twenty-three models, synthesised live -- pick one, pick a note, and drive TIMBRE and COLOR while the machine runs.
Install UI Factory (Workshop item 2913469777) for the block's own panel, which names the models, says what the two controls do in each of them, draws the wave coming out, and will play it while you are still building. Without it the block uses Besiege's ordinary block mapper.
